chapter.verse: Tua ciangin kumpi-tokhom tunga a tupa' taklam khut ah laihuala khat ka mu hi. Tua laihual a sung leh a nungah lai kigelh a, ciaptehna gip sagih kibelh hi.
Tua ciangin a thahat vanmi khat ka mu a, “Laihual a zal ding leh gipte a khokkhia ding kua kilawm hiam?” ci-in awging lianpi tawh tangko hi.
Vantung hileh leitung hileh laihual a zal ding ahi zongin, a sung a en ding ahi zongin a hizo kuamah om lo hi.
Laihual a zal dingin leh a sung a en dingin a kilawm kuamah a om loh manin nakpi-in kah ka kipan hi.
Tua laitak makaite khat in kei hong hopih a, “Kap nawnkei in. En in, laihual leh gip sagihte a zal thei dingin Judah behte' Humpi ahi David' Bulsel gualzo khinta hi,” hong ci hi.

Tua ciangin leitung mun citeng ah a kisawlkhia Pasian' kha sagih cihna ahi saki sagih leh mittang sagih a nei, a kigolum tawh a kibang Tuuno a ding khat, kumpi-tokhom leh sahing lite' kikal, makaite' lakah ka mu hi.
Tua Tuuno va pai-in kumpi-tokhom tunga a tupa' taklam khut pan laihual va la hi.

Laihual a ngah ciangin sahing lite leh makai sawmnih-le-lite in harpe khausai ahi zongin, mi siangthote' thungetna ahi paknamtui a dimin omna kham kuang-uk ahi zongin, khat ciat tawi-in Tuuno' mai-ah boksuk uh a,

hih bangin la thak khat sa uh hi: “Laihual a la dingin leh gipte a khokkhia dingin nang na kilawm hi, a hang pen nang hong kigolum a, na sisan tawh minam, kampau, tualmi, khualmi a namkim sungpan Pasian' adingin mipawl na lei hi,
Amaute i Pasian' adingin kumpigam khat leh siampite na suaksak a, amaute in leitung uk ding uh hi.”
Tua ciangin ka khuadak leh kumpi-tokhom, sahingte leh makaite' kimkot ah vanmi simzawhloh tulthen tampite' awging ka za a,
awging lianpi tawh hih bangin ci uh hi: “A kigolum Tuuno a kilawm hi, vangliatna, hauhna, pilna, thahatna, pahtawina, minphatna leh thupha paihna a sang dingin kilawm hi.”

Tua banah vantung, leitung, leinuai leh tuipi sunga piansakte khempeuh, tuate sunga om khempeuh, hih bangin a cih uh ka za hi: “Tokhom tunga a tupa' tung leh Tuuno' tungah thupha paihna, pahtawina, minphatna, leh thahatna a tawntung a tawntungin om ta hen.”
Tua ciangin sahing lite in, “Amen,” ci uh a, makaite zong boksukin bia uh hi.
